remarks: Stamford's best kept secret. Bishop Meadows is hidden gem tucked away in quiet neighborhood. A short walk to the park, Beach, Pickle Ball,Tennis and more. Close to restaurants, grocery store, I95 and Stamford train station. Condo features 2 levels. On main floor, Newer kitchen ,features: Stainless steel appliances and breakfast bar. Living room has new flooring just installed, leads to the deck. Seperate dining space. Large BR with multiple closets. Lower level boasts Family room w/ sliders that lead to outside grass area. Laundry room with newer washer/dryer and brand new hot water heater. Bishop Meadows is a quaint community with Club,Sauna and beautiful inground pool. A beautiful place to call home.
